facts.statement: Free Realms was one of six SOE games participating in the spring Station Cash promotion, alongside EverQuest, EverQuest II, EverQuest II Extended, Star Wars Galaxies and Clone Wars Adventures.
facts.quote: Estarán participando EverQuest, EverQuest II, EverQuest II extendido, Free Realms

article_summaries.title: Fiebre de la Super Fan de primavera
article_summaries.summary: This Spanish-language freerealms.com news page (captured under the title 'Free Realms - What is New?') is a cross-game SOE promotion, not a Free Realms update. It says that from April 22 to April 25, purchases of Station Cash were doubled, excluding SMS purchases, and that Free Realms was one of six SOE titles taking part. The post gives no year, so the event year cannot be confirmed from the page.
